name: astradock-local
description: Local Star Citizen log companion for recent shard history.

scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run test:node && npm run test:renderer
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build:renderer && electron-builder --dir
scripts.dist: npm run typecheck && npm run build:renderer && electron-builder
scripts.dist:standalone:win: npm run typecheck && npm run build:renderer && electron-builder --win portable --x64 --publish never --config.directories.output=dist/standalone
scripts.dist:standalone:exporter:win: npm run typecheck && npm run build:renderer:exporter && electron-builder --win portable --x64 --publish never --config.directories.output=dist/standalone-exporter --config.portable.artifactName='AstraDock-Local-${version}-blueprint-exporter-${arch}.${ext}'
scripts.dist:standalone:exporter:linux: npm run typecheck && npm run build:renderer:exporter && electron-builder --linux AppImage --x64 --publish never --config.directories.output=dist/standalone-exporter-linux
scripts.dist:standalone:linux: npm run typecheck && npm run build:renderer && electron-builder --linux AppImage --x64 --publish never --config.directories.output=dist/standalone
